Latest Update: « Il m’appelait tous les jours » : Thierry Henry déballe tout sur Michael Olise !

📅 12 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (646 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Le10sport

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Invité dans le podcast Kampo animé par le journaliste Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry s'est longuement livré sur les coulisses des Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024.
  • Industry observers note that en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore.
  • L'attaquant a fait le forcing pour s'assurer une place dans le groupe olympique.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Invité dans le podcast Kampo animé par le journaliste Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry s'est longuement livré sur les coulisses des Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. L'ancien sélectionneur de l'équipe de France olympique a révélé la détermination totale de Michael Olise pour disputer le tournoi sous le maillot tricolore.

Industry observers note that en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore. Le tournoi olympique de football n'étant pas inscrit sur les dates officielles du calendrier de la FIFA, les clubs professionnels n'avaient aucune obligation légale de libérer leurs joueurs. Cette absence de contrainte réglementaire avait grandement compliqué la tâche de Thierry Henry pour composer son groupe. Face à ces nombreux refus, Michael Olise a adopté une démarche diamétralement opposée.

L'attaquant a fait le forcing pour s'assurer une place dans le groupe olympique. Alors que Gareth Southgate souhaitait le convoquer avec les A de l'équipe d'Angleterre pour disputer l'Euro 2024, Michael Olise a écarté cette opportunité pour privilégier le maillot tricolore. Le joueur a ainsi multiplié les appels téléphoniques directs avec le sélectionneur français. Dans le podcast Kampo animé par Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry a détaillé cette insistance quotidienne : « Michael, il m’appelait tous les jours pour aller aux JO, alors qu’il y avait l’équipe d’Angleterre qui le voulait pour aller au Championnat d’Europe avec les A. Il aurait pu aller à l’Euro avec l’Angleterre. Mais il m’appelait tous les jours. Son envie de jouer pour l’équipe de France était extraordinaire. Moi, je n’ai convaincu personne. ».

Né à Londres en 2001 d'un père nigérian et d'une mère franco-algérienne, Michael Olise disposait sur le plan sportif de plusieurs options internationales. L'attaquant était éligible pour quatre sélections nationales différentes : la France, l'Angleterre, le Nigeria et l'Algérie. Toutefois, Michael Olise a toujours accordé sa préférence absolue à l'équipe de France. Au-delà des approches anglaises, le joueur a fait preuve d'une fermeté totale au moment de quitter Crystal Palace pour rejoindre l'Allemagne.

Recruté par le Bayern Munich pour 53 millions d'euros selon Foot Mercato, et plus de 60 millions d'euros d'après d'autres sources, il a imposé sa participation aux Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. Le joueur a ainsi pris le risque de se heurter à sa nouvelle direction bavaroise pour défendre les couleurs tricolores. Thierry Henry a salué cette prise de position au micro de Smaïl Bouabdellah : « Michael Olise aime l’équipe de France depuis qu’il est petit. Certains joueurs ne voulaient pas venir. Pas de problème, je n’en veux à personne. Mais un mec de ce calibre est venu, alors qu’il y avait le risque de s’embrouiller avec son nouveau club. Il m’a dit: 'Où je vais, je vais dire à mon club que je vais aux Jeux olympiques, c’est tout.’ On parle de Michael Olise. Mon respect pour lui est énorme. ».

Industry observers note that sur le terrain, ce choix a porté ses fruits tout au long de la compétition estivale. Titulaire lors des 6 matches du tournoi olympique, Michael Olise a compilé 2 buts et 5 passes décisives sous les ordres de Thierry Henry. Ce parcours s'est achevé par une médaille d'argent décrochée le 9 août 2024 au Parc des Princes, après une finale disputée contre l'Espagne (3-5 après prolongation).

Sources indicate that au-delà de ce bilan chiffré, Thierry Henry qualifie Michael Olise de génie qu'il ne faut pas brider. Dans le podcast Kampo, l'ancien joueur d'Arsenal a ainsi développé son analyse sur le talent de son ancien joueur : « Michael, il est à part parce qu’il pense différemment. À un moment donné, les génies, il ne faut pas essayer de les comprendre. C’est un génie ? Ah, de très loin, très très loin. (…) Est-ce que tu vas, toi, dire à un peintre comment peindre ? Pourquoi tu veux bloquer un génie ? ».

#107977. Xabi Alonso hits out at ‘soft’ Chelsea players

Xabi Alonso hits out at ‘soft’ Chelsea players

📅 12 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 23 min read (4608 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~23 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Xabi Alonso accused his Chelsea players of being “soft” after they failed to keep a clean sheet for the 20th successive Premier League game.
  • Chelsea threw away an early lead to draw 2-2 with Hull City and have conceded two or more goals in each of their four Premier League games.
  • Alonso has tried different systems and different players in those games, but suggested Chelsea’s biggest problem is mental.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Xabi Alonso accused his Chelsea players of being “soft” after they failed to keep a clean sheet for the 20th successive Premier League game.

Chelsea threw away an early lead to draw 2-2 with Hull City and have conceded two or more goals in each of their four Premier League games.

Alonso has tried different systems and different players in those games, but suggested Chelsea’s biggest problem is mental.

The club’s dreadful clean-sheet record pre-dates him and is the first time in 65 years Chelsea have gone 20 league games without keeping the opposition out.

According to recent reports, hull’s first goal from Mohamed Belloumi came after the ball had bounced over Jorrel Hato and Alonso stated: “We need to be aware that from any situation, any team in the Premier League can hurt you. Today it was from a long ball, two bounces, the way it happened. You need to be very aware, very ready that the danger can come from any situation. If you are soft or if you are not prepared, you will get punished and we have been punished that way.”.

Chelsea have shared 30 goals with their opponents in the club’s six games in all competitions so far this season.

“Yeah, it’s all maybe entertaining, but I hope that one day you say it was a boring game and we win and we don’t give these entertaining moments,” he said.

“But, for sure, it kind of repeats some patterns that we are making. It will take time to... or it will take moments to fix them when we get the lead and you still need to be competing and not give the chance so easily for them to come back, especially in the first goal, we can do much better.

Sources indicate that “It was too soft to give them this hope because until then we were controlling, we were creating chances. But that momentum that we had changed the mood and the score of the game, and it’s something that we need to be talking [about], we address and we will get better. But it’s having an impact on our performances at the moment.”.

Industry observers note that asked if his players have a real desire to defend and keep clean sheets, Alonso said: “We can do better, we can do better for sure. We need to know that even when we have the lead, a very important part of the game is to hold together, to keep the distance, to go intense in the situations to defend. I’m sure that we can do better.

“Overall, I think that we are attacking better than defending in every part. We know that it’s a major topic and a big theme for us. For sure, it’s just four games. But the dynamic in terms of conceding, I don’t like it and we need to do much better. Open play, set-pieces, long balls, this toughness, this competitive sense, we can do better.”.

Needing three goals or more to win games is not sustainable, as Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso is finding out.

In a recent development, this is not a problem of Alonso’s making, given Chelsea have now gone 20 Premier League games without a clean sheet. But he is certainly not improving the concern yet.

Chelsea beat Fulham with three goals and Brighton with four but left themselves far too much to do against Arsenal and were taken advantage of by Hull City, who will be slightly disappointed they did not leave Stamford Bridge with all three points.

Goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez has now conceded seven goals in three games since joining from Aston Villa, while central defender Maxence Lacroix, who joined for £52m from Crystal Palace in the summer, was relegated to the substitutes’ bench.

Martínez was at fault for Mohamed Belloumi’s second goal, but the Argentine did make a crucial save at his back post to stop substitute Mohamed-Ali Cho grabbing a winner that Chelsea could have had no complaints about.

Hull finished the game with more shots on goal than their hosts and a higher expected-goals rate. Chelsea are far too open and in some ways far too entertaining.

It has been revealed that defensive midfielder Moisés Caicedo cannot return from injury promptly enough, but this does not feel like a problem that will be solved by one man. Alonso needs to find a balance and instil a real desire in his team to defend.

Caicedo has that desire, but there are no defenders at the club who have shown that absolute desperation to keep the ball out of the net that Chelsea fans became so used to in the days of John Terry, Gary Cahill and César Azpilicueta.

Sources indicate that none of this should diminish Hull’s performance. They were not only spirited and full of character but also highlighted quality and a threat. The joke is presently on those who laughed at their hopes of survival before a ball had been kicked.

It is now two wins and two draws for Sergej Jakirovic’s team and they are already a fifth of the way to 40 points. Jakirovic had promised his staff a week off in the international break if they reached eight points after five games. With that target already met, there may be a new reward if Hull can make it 11 points against Newcastle United next weekend.

According to recent reports, “Before the season, I noted to my staff that we will take seven, eight points in these first five and then I will give them seven days off,” Jakirovic said. “That was our target and now we are in a very good position, eight points.

“Especially today, it’s very, very difficult to play here, and now we will try to get even more. Of course, I’m a little bit worried about the international break because we have 13 national team players. But we will see who will come back and in what condition. So this is my concern right now.” Asked if his staff’s seven-day break will be extended if Hull can beat Newcastle, Jakirovic added: “I will tell them. But I know already.”.

Industry observers note that while his five-game target may need modifying, Jakirovic is not deviating from his goal for the season for Hull. “Our target is always to stay in the league and collect as many points as possible,” he said. “Forty points, 38 to 41, this is the average we need. Then it’s easier to play. You can play more relaxed, with more joy and happiness. So [get to] this as soon as possible, so that we are safe.”.

Recent findings suggest that hull had not conceded a league goal before this and there had been predictions they might crumble when they finally let the ball into their net. They did so after just seven minutes but they kept their heads and came back stronger.

It was far too easy for Morgan Rogers to make a yard of space for himself to shoot after collecting the ball from João Pedro, and Hull goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis may not have been happy to have been beaten at his near post.

In a recent development, chelsea have now scored inside the first 10 minutes in all of their four league games, but Hull were in no mood to crumble and hit back with two goals in six minutes from Belloumi to take a half-time lead. Both Hull goals were shockers from Chelsea’s perspective. The first, in the 28th minute, came as a result of Jorrel Hato letting the ball bounce over him from a Ryan Giles cross and Belloumi finished brilliantly.

Belloumi’s second came after Martínez had flapped at a corner and Semi Ajayi had hit the bar with a header. The ball fell to Belloumi again and his shot was deflected into the net.

In a recent development, it was no surprise that Hato did not reappear for the second half, as he was replaced by Pep Chavarría at left-back. But Chelsea remained vulnerable and Martínez had to recover from spilling a Regan Slater shot to prevent Ollie McBurnie extending Hull’s advantage.

When Palmer and Pedro combined for Pedro to sweep the ball into the net and equalise with 24 minutes remaining, it seemed like it would be Chelsea who would provide the grandstand finish.

But it was Hull who got a second wind and Chelsea were indebted to Martínez for making a save to stop Cho securing all three points and sending the visiting fans home even happier.

Recent findings suggest that I feel good. We have to be happy. It’s a huge result for us.

Sources indicate that we had 2-1 at half-time and we had a 100 per cent chance with McBurnie but Martinez’s save was excellent. We have to control play better in the box because we can stop this [Chelsea goal]. We had an excellent chance for Cho – Martinez saved again. Player of the match.

We can be very happy. We took a point in a very demanding match.

Eight points against very difficult opponents. We have to continue like this.

There have been 12 Premier League games at Anfield in 2026, Liverpool have only won 4 of them to date. This was seventh draw and Fulham deserves their share of the spoils. This was very much a learning experience for Andoni Iraola.

Not a single home win in the Premier League, today.

Aston Villa 1 Nottingham Forest 2Bournemouth 2 Brentford 2Chelsea 2 Hull City 2Crystal Palace 2 Ipswich Town 3Liverpool 0 Fulham 0.

What a result for Hull, who remain unbeaten and they have taken five points from fixtures against United, Villa and Chelsea.

That is the first really poor result of the Alonso era, points dropped.

What a thriller in SE25, both teams have been going for it in the closing stages, but Ipswich have surely score the winner through Zian Flemming.

Fulham were pointless before this game, but they have kept a clean sheet at Anfield with a disciplined display and they could well have score one or two. Underwhelming for Liverpool, who have not won just one of their first four games and their fixtures have not been the most taxing.

And as we predicted at the beginning of the game... Liverpool 0 Fulham 0. If this reporter ever gives you advice on a horse to back or a team to follow, make sure you take the opposite stance. Fulham deserve their reward and their fans are singing “We got a point!”.

Villa are finishing the game with 10 men because Ian Maatsen pulled up after Emery had made his five substitutions, and Forest have punished them through Igor Jesus with just a few minutes of normal time to play.

Industry observers note that alexander Isak heads over the bar when he perhaps should have hit the target. Has time run out for Liverpool?

You might imagine Chelsea are battering down the door, but Mohamed-Ali Cho has just forced Emi Martinez into a save at the other end. Hull will remain unbeaten if they can hold out.

Strand Larsen has had his critics, but he has scored his first goal of the season to set up a grandstand finish with 15 minutes plus stoppage time to play at Selhurst Park.

Short corner, McGinn whipped in an inswinging cross that is glanced into the bottom corner by Alysson.

Liverpool continue to toil at Anfield, but no opening goal. Iraola has thrown on Frimpong, Mac Allister, Ngumoha and Gakpo in the second half. Fulham have had the chances to score at least one, and Josh King has just brought a save out of Alisson.

Industry observers note that hull are a little lucky they still have 11 men on the pitch. Already on a booking, my man Crooks bundled down Rogers. It could easily have been another yellow car but the referee let him off and now he’s been replaced by Iroegbunam.

Joao Pedro finds the smallest of gaps to be the goalkeeper and find the roof of the net with a brilliant, instinctive finish.

According to recent reports, that had not really been coming for Chelsea. It all felt a bit easy for Palmer to get his low cross into the box and Pedro to sweep the ball in. The home fans have woken up again.

Martinez was lucky to get away with another slip up, there. He spilt Slater’s shot but reacted before McBurnie to stop the Hull striker scoring the rebound. Just a day after his nasty looking crash, Sorba Thomas is on for Hull.

This game is absolutely here for Fulham to win. Quietness has descended around Anfield, the hosts have no fluency in their play and Fulham are growing in confidence. Why wouldn’t they after getting to 65 minutes with a clean sheet?

In a recent development, just like in the first half, four minutes after one of these teams taking the lead there has been an equaliser. Kevin Scahde is in a rich vein of form.

Bournemouth have have never beaten Brentford in the Premier League, but they might well be on their way to changing that record having trailed earlier in the game. Marcus Tavernier has just scored their second goal.

Matt Davidson Rider Crooks has just been booked for a very cynical foul on Rogers. It gave Chelsea a free-kick in a dangerous position Reece James had an effort tipped away. Chelsea have started the second half well.

Sources indicate that within a minute of the restart, Villa lose the ball in midfield and Delap punishes them to the maximum. Cracking finish from just outside the box, and a much-needed goal by Delap. The Glasner curse striking for Emery again?

Liam Delap has just started paying back that £50m transfer fee with a fine goal.

Delap picked the ball up on the left and set himself up on the edge of the box before crashing a 25-yard shot past Zion Suzuki.

Unai Emery has made a couple of changes at half-time, taking off Nicolas Jackson who picked up a silly booking just before half-time.

Tammy Abraham is on in his place. George Hemmings is also off and replaced by Alysson.

According to recent reports, pep Chavarria on for Chelsea at half-time. He’s replaced Jorrel Hato, who had a bit of a stinker in the first half.

Recent findings suggest that andoni Iraola hasn’t hung about here. Milos Kerkez has come on immediately after half-time for Kostas Tsimikas and you can say with certainty that Liverpool will be shopping for a new left-back in due course.

Recent findings suggest that so at half-time, Hull City are top of the Premier League and don’t their supporters know it? They were singing “we are top of the League” for the full two minutes of time added on for stoppages at the end of the first period. Alonso has some work to do at the break.

Forest did need a brilliant double save from Matz Sels to deny Victor Lindelof and have recovered to slow the match down.

Neco Williams wasted a decent chance for Forest from outside the penalty area shortly before the break.

Referee Andrew Madley has irritated both teams with a number of weird decisions - but that’s sadly par for the course with officials nowadays.

Villa 0 Forest 0Bournemouth 1 Brentford 1Chelsea 1 Hull City 2Palace 1 Ipswich 2Liverpool 0 Fulham 0.

It has been revealed that palace in some trouble now, level with Ipswich and down to 10 men. Disasi was sent off in the 34th minute for a reckless challenge on Jack Clarke, caught him with studs on shin.

Things got worse for Palace just before half-time, with Leif Davis heading home at the back post to give Ipswich the league.

Apologies for the lack of updates, some technical gremlins at Telegraph Towers. A nip and tuck game as expected at at the Vitality: Kevin Schade gave Brentford the lead before Justin Kluivert equalised four minutes later.

One way to put it is that Kostas Tsimikas isn’t playing well. Another way to say it would be that his efforts are making Milos Kerkez look like Roberto Carlos. The Greek left-back is having a dreadful afternoon and Fulham are getting plenty of joy out of him. We suggested there was no chance of this game finishing goalless, and it’s anomalous that we have reached 40 minutes without score. Fulham, certainly, have a sense of adventure and have been into Liverpool’s 18-yard box plenty of times. Let’s see if the picture changes before the interval.

Sources indicate that that’s now seven goals Emi Martinez has conceded in three games since joining from Villa to supposedly solve Chelsea’s goalkeeping crisis. Martinez won’t be pleased with Hull’s second goal, here. He was beaten to a corner by Ajayi. His header hit the bar and Belloumi’s shot was deflected past him. The Hull fans are in dreamland.

According to recent reports, this is a turn up for the books. Chelsea undone by a long ball forward, and Hato lets the ball bounce over his head, and Belloumi finishes with aplomb.

That’s now 20 Premier League games Chelsea have gone without keeping a clean sheet. What an earth was Jorrel Hato doing, letting the ball bounce over him for Belloumi? Amateur stuff at the back from the home side. It was Hull’s first meaningful attack.

Emersonn has struggled in some games so far this season, but he has just planted a header into the corner from a Davis cross.

There is a VAR check for offside... but the goal stands.

Austin MacPhee, Chelsea’s flamboyant set-piece coach, just motioned for Xabi Alonso to sit down when the Blues manager momentarily got up from his seat when the home side were preparing to take a corner. It seems MacPhee wears the (correct length) trousers when it comes to set pieces.

An almighty let off for Alisson and Liverpool after pass from the goalkeeper played Gravenberch into trouble, but Jacquet cleared off the line to keep the game goalless. That was Fulham’s first foray forward.

Industry observers note that A bright start in this game and there is no chance it will end goalless (famous last words). Liverpool should already be one up but Alexander Isak’s shot has just drifted across the face of goal but the signs are encouraging. It could be a long afternoon for Alvaro Arbeloa.

Wow. Unbelievable double save from Forest’s Matz Sels there to keep out Victor Lindelof.

We are under way in the five Premier League 3pm kick-offs. Goals and further updates from around the grounds as they happen.

Some early #analysis from Matt at the Bridge, about one of Hull’s midfielders.

Matt Crooks is absolutely massive.

Will we get another fast start from Chelsea today? They have scored inside the first five minutes in all three of their League games this season. Hull are yet to concede.

Unai Emery is possibly the best coach in the Premier League but has found past encounters with Oliver Glasner very uncomfortable.

Since Glasner’s arrival in English football with Crystal Palace in February 2024, he has faced Emery’s Villa seven times and never lost.

With five victories and two draws, it is an impressive record albeit with a different set of players.

Aston Villa and Forest are two teams in transition, and meet for the first time since that two-legged Europa League semi-final last season.

Villa are building a latest chapter after a summer of significant change, while Forest are implementing a totally different style of play under Oliver Glasner.

Industry observers note that there have been signs of progress at both of the former European Cup winners. Villa secured an impressive victory over Club Brugge in the Champions League on Tuesday. Forest are improving under Glasner, with their best performance the 2-2 draw at Liverpool.

« Il a haussé le ton » : Zinédine Zidane a secoué les Bleus !

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie.
  • In a recent development, dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux.
  • Industry observers note that dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie. Un sursaut salutaire provoqué par Zinédine Zidane, qui n'a pas hésité à hausser le ton dans le vestiaire.

In a recent development, dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Trois jours après le revers concédé face à l'Italie à San Siro, premier accroc de l'ère Zinédine Zidane, les Tricolores se devaient de réagir. Toutefois, à la pause, le score restait nul et vierge (0-0), actant un dixième match de suite sans marquer lors du premier acte. Un manque d'efficacité chronique qui a fini par agacer le sélectionneur.

Industry observers note that dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive. Le sélectionneur souhaitait corriger l'apathie collective et le manque d'agressivité à la perte du ballon constatés durant le premier acte. Une mise au point nécessaire pour relancer son équipe. Au micro de TF1 après la rencontre, le défenseur de Liverpool Jérémy Jacquet a ainsi dévoilé la teneur du discours : « Le coach nous a dit à la mi-temps qu’il trouvait qu’on n’était pas assez agressifs à la perte du ballon. On l’a bien rectifié en deuxième. […] Pour être honnête, il n’a pas gueulé, mais a haussé le ton sur nos axes de progression à la perte de balle. Pour lui, on pouvait faire mieux. Il trouvait qu’on gardait trop le ballon et voulait que l’on bouge plus. ».

Sources indicate that de son côté, le technicien tricolore a confirmé avoir bousculé ses troupes tout en restant mesuré, préférant insister sur les ajustements tactiques exigés sur la pelouse. « Ce n'est pas la défense. C'est tous ensemble. On doit aller presser tous ensemble et quand on ne presse pas, on se resserre tous ensemble. C'est des choses qu'on doit mettre en place. On a besoin de garder le ballon. On aime courir avec ballon, sans ballon, ce n'est pas notre truc. On l'a mieux en seconde période en jouant en deux touches. On doit le répéter. Les murs n’ont pas tremblé à la mi-temps. On a rectifié des choses et c’était mieux en seconde. La réaction était très bonne », a détaillé Zinédine Zidane sur TF1.

En effet, la copie rendue au cours des quarante-cinq premières minutes a déçu le patron des Bleus. Malgré une possession de balle établie à 60 %, la France n'a jamais su emballer la rencontre, gaspillant de l'énergie à courir après le cuir tout en concédant de larges décalages. Le pressing tricolore s'est révélé particulièrement inefficace. Sur le plateau de TF1, Zinédine Zidane a ainsi exprimé sa frustration : « C'était l'objectif de se qualifier, en étant éventuellement premier. Par contre, sur le contenu, on peut être un peu perplexe, surtout dans notre pression en première mi-temps. Quand on ne voit pas certaines choses sur le terrain, on est un peu frustrés. C'est surtout dans la pression, parce qu'on laissait faire les décalages et on n'a pas été bons du tout dans notre pression. On a rectifié ça à la mi-temps et on a été meilleurs après. Ce sont des choses où on doit encore s'améliorer. Moi, je n'étais pas content, les joueurs non plus. Mais on a rectifié. ».

It has been revealed that D'ailleurs, le sélectionneur a réitéré son agacement en conférence de presse d'après-match pour cibler ce dysfonctionnement inhabituel. Pour Zinédine Zidane, son équipe a été défaillante dans sa première ligne de récupération en concédant bien trop de liberté à l'adversaire : « Ce qui n’a pas été bon, c’est notre première pression. On l’a très bien fait sur les cinq autres matchs, même contre l’Italie. En revanche, ce soir, on a été défaillants, notamment en première mi-temps. On a laissé beaucoup trop d’espaces. On a rectifié le tir en deuxième mi-temps où on a été très bons dans l’utilisation du ballon. Même si on peut encore mieux faire, parce que j’ai des joueurs de qualité qui peuvent garder le ballon. Ce sont eux (les Turcs) qui doivent courir derrière le ballon », a insisté Zinédine Zidane.

In a recent development, au retour des vestiaires, le discours du sélectionneur a porté ses fruits. Nettement plus agressifs et tranchants en jouant en deux touches de balle, les Bleus ont rapidement trouvé la faille sur un but contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu (49e). Lancés, les Tricolores ont ensuite fait le break grâce à Éli Junior Kroupi (79e). La réduction du score tardive d'Abdülkerim Bardakcı (89e) n'a rien changé à l'matter de la rencontre (2-1). Une réaction salutaire.

Ainsi, ce succès combiné à la défaite de l'Italie contre la Belgique (1-4) permet à la France de terminer à la première place de sa poule. Les hommes de Zinédine Zidane valident officiellement leur qualification pour les quarts de finale du Final 8 de la Ligue des nations. Les Bleus connaîtront leur prochain adversaire lors du tirage au sort programmé le vendredi 20 novembre 2026 en Suisse, avant d'aborder cette double confrontation en mars 2027.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that au sortir de la victoire obtenue face à la Turquie dimanche soir à Bordeaux, Zinédine Zidane n'a pas pu débriefer la rencontre avec ses troupes dans le vestiaire. En raison des départs précipités des joueurs, le sélectionneur de l'équipe de France a dû faire l'impasse sur son discours d'après-match.

Recent findings suggest that dimanche 15 novembre 2026, l'équipe de France a conclu sa phase de groupes de Ligue des nations par un succès contre la Turquie (2-1), devant 42 000 spectateurs au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Lors de cette 6e et dernière journée, les Bleus ont marqué un premier but grâce à une réalisation contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu à la 49e minute, puis un deuxième avec Éli Junior Kroupi à la 80e minute, avant la réduction du score turque par Abdülkerim Bardakcı à la 90e minute. Le coup de sifflet final a retenti à 22h38. Une fin de soirée agitée.

À 22h40, les Bleus ont effectué un timide tour d'honneur autour du rond central plutôt qu'autour du terrain, sans plusieurs cadres dont le capitaine Kylian Mbappé qui avait déjà quitté la pelouse. D'ailleurs, la distance entre les joueurs et les tribunes lors de ce tour d'honneur a provoqué quelques sifflets de supporters français déçus.

En effet, les départs se sont enchaînés à toute vitesse. Kylian Mbappé a quitté le stade Atlantique à 22h53, soit exactement quinze minutes après le coup de sifflet final, plusieurs témoins évoquant un joueur très pressé. Rayan Cherki et Malo Gusto ont ensuite quitté le stade ensemble valise à la main, suivis par Eduardo Camavinga. Une course contre la montre.

Et pour cause, la fermeture avancée de l'aéroport de Bordeaux-Mérignac imposait un timing très serré. Plusieurs avions privés étaient ainsi prévus au décollage : un jet pour Milan à 00h05 et un autre pour Madrid à 00h12. De son côté, l'avion de la Fédération Française de Football a quitté la Gironde à 1h15.

Passés en zone d'interviews, Andy Diouf et Pablo Pagis ont tous les deux confirmé l'absence de discours de Zinédine Zidane dans le vestiaire. « On n’a pas fait de discours », a déclaré Andy Diouf devant les micros. De son côté, Pablo Pagis a détaillé la gestion du sélectionneur tricolore : « Il a laissé tout le monde tranquille ».

Zinédine Zidane n'a pas retenu ses joueurs pressés en raison de la fatigue et du calendrier très serré de ce rassemblement de novembre, qui comptait deux matches en 72 heures.

Industry observers note that au-delà de cette fin de soirée au pas de course dans les couloirs du stade bordelais, les Tricolores ont validé leur qualification. Le prochain rendez-vous des Bleus de Zidane est fixé du 25 au 30 mars 2027 pour les quarts de finale aller-retour de la Ligue des nations.

Harry Kane's injury blow: Ballon d'Or winner sends upbeat message from hospital amid England concerns captain will be out for MONTHS after tearing ligaments

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 17:58 EST, 20 November 2026 | Updated: 10:47 EST, 21 November 2026.
  • Bayern Munich fear Harry Kane will be ruled out for months after suffering an ankle injury in their Bundesliga draw against Cologne - with the striker revealing he will only return for 'the business end of the season'.
  • Kane was forced off just 20 minutes into the match at the Allianz Arena following a challenge from Joel Schmied.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By MICHAEL PAVITT, SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 17:58 EST, 20 November 2026 | Updated: 10:47 EST, 21 November 2026.

Bayern Munich fear Harry Kane will be ruled out for months after suffering an ankle injury in their Bundesliga draw against Cologne - with the striker revealing he will only return for 'the business end of the season'.

Kane was forced off just 20 minutes into the match at the Allianz Arena following a challenge from Joel Schmied.

The defender had won the ball but caught Kane with his follow through on his ankle.

Kane had initially tried to play on after treatment, before eventually needing to be replaced.

The Ballon d'Or winner was upbeat on Saturday morning however, sharing a message with his fans that stressed his readiness to come back better than ever.

According to recent reports, 'The highs and lows of life!' Kane captioned a picture of himself wearing a protective boot. 'Obviously very disappointed to get this injury but as always it's an opportunity to show resilience and improvement going in 2027.

Harry Kane was forced off during Bayern Munich's draw against Cologne on Friday night.

Bayern confirmed the England captain is set to be out for months following the injury.

But despite his injury, Kane was upbeat as he spoke to fans for the first time on Saturday (Source: Harry Kane/X).

'I'll be back fresh and ready to go for the business end of the season!

'"Tough times don't last, tough people do" - my guy (Julian Edelman) told me this one!' Kane added, quoting the NFL icon.

It has been revealed that 'Thank you for all the messages! Alles gut (red heart emoji, strong arm emoji).'.

Speaking post-match, Bayern sporting director Max Eberl revealed that Kane has suffered ligament damage.

A Bayern club statement confirmed the blow, reading: 'Harry Kane suffered a tear of the syndesmosis ligament in his left ankle in Bayern Munich’s Bundesliga home match against 1. FC Köln on Friday evening.

'This was confirmed by an examination by Bayern Munich’s medical department.

Industry observers note that 'The 33-year-old will therefore be out for the next few months. Get well soon Harry.'.

Kane's absence will be a major blow for Bayern, with the Ballon d'Or winner having scored ten goals in 16 matches so far this season.

Bayern, who are already without Luis Diaz, Saibari and Serge Gnabry, also saw Michael Olise come off at half-time.

The German giants later confirmed Olise had suffered a 'contusion of the forefoot', with the Frenchman set to undergo treatment in the coming days.

It remains to be seen whether Kane - who became England's most-capped player last week when making his 126th appearance in the 2-1 win over Croatia - is at risk of missing the Nations League quarter-final against Norway in March.

Vincent Kompany, who was back in the dugout for the first time since his collapse last month, admitted other players will have to step up for Bayern in the absence of star names such as Kane.

'These are world-class players, you can't replace them, but we have the mentality and we have to bring that now,' Kompany stated, as per Bild.

'We need incredible performances from players who may not yet be used to this pressure at FC Bayern.

Bayern were held to a 1-1 draw by Cologne on Vincent Kompany's return to the touchline.

Recent findings suggest that 'We will all try together to make this situation a positive one for ourselves. FC Bayern does this time and time again, and that's what we want to do now too.'.

Bayern were ultimately held to a 1-1 draw by Cologne, with Tottenham loanee Mikey Moore giving the visitors a shock first half lead at the Allianz Arena.

Nathaniel Brown drew Bayern level before half-time, but the hosts were unable to find a winner on Kompany's return.

The draw gives Borussia Dortmund the chance to move to the top of the Bundesliga table on Saturday.

Breaking: « Romario parle beaucoup » : La mise au point cinglante d'Ancelotti avec le Brésil !

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (766 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Le10sport

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • In a recent development, ciblé par de vives critiques après la récente défaite du Brésil, Carlo Ancelotti a réagi ce lundi avec une fermeté inhabituelle.
  • La tension est montée d'un cran autour de la sélection brésilienne depuis le revers concédé face au Japon (3-2), samedi 14 novembre 2026, au Stade national de Singapour.
  • Présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Singapour, Carlo Ancelotti a été invité à réagir aux attaques formulées par l'ancien attaquant de la Seleção.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, ciblé par de vives critiques après la récente défaite du Brésil, Carlo Ancelotti a réagi ce lundi avec une fermeté inhabituelle. Le sélectionneur de la Seleção a sèchement répondu aux attaques de Romario, qui réclamait publiquement son départ immédiat.

La tension est montée d'un cran autour de la sélection brésilienne depuis le revers concédé face au Japon (3-2), samedi 14 novembre 2026, au Stade national de Singapour. Alors que les Japonais menaient rapidement grâce à Takefusa Kubo et Keito Nakamura, le doublé de Vinícius Júnior (33e, 75e) avait pourtant permis aux Auriverdes d'égaliser. Toutefois, le but concédé à Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (91e) dans le temps additionnel a scellé la défaite brésilienne.

Présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Singapour, Carlo Ancelotti a été invité à réagir aux attaques formulées par l'ancien attaquant de la Seleção. Le technicien italien a répondu en espagnol à l'ancien international. Une mise au point limpide. « C'est la liberté d'expression et, dans un pays démocratique, tout le monde peut avoir une opinion. Romario a donné la sienne, et tout le monde a le droit de dire des mensonges, des vérités ou des bêtises. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que Romario parle beaucoup, et il est dans son droit », a ainsi rétorqué l'entraîneur face aux journalistes.

Cette sortie directe démontre la volonté du sélectionneur de balayer la polémique alors que la pression médiatique s'accentue. Carlo Ancelotti n'a pas souhaité polémiquer davantage avec l'ancienne gloire du football brésilien, se contentant de souligner avec ironie l'omniprésence médiatique de son détracteur.

Recent findings suggest that deux jours plus tôt, Romario n'avait pas mâché ses mots à la suite de la défaite concédée face à l'équipe nippone. L'ancien buteur brésilien avait réclamé la destitution immédiate du sélectionneur sur ses réseaux sociaux, estimant qu'Ancelotti ne disposait pas des qualités requises pour diriger le pays. « Ça suffit ! Prends tes affaires et va-t'en ! », avait notamment écrit Romario, très remonté contre l'entraîneur italien.

Au-delà de cette interpellation, Romario a tout de même reconnu les accomplissements passés de Carlo Ancelotti, qualifié d'« un des grands entraîneurs » en club, tout en appelant à son retour sur le Vieux Continent : « Retourne dans les clubs, où tu t'es fait un nom, car la sélection brésilienne ne peut pas continuer à prendre ce risque ». L'ancien international a également interpellé le président de la Confédération brésilienne de football (CBF), Samir Xaud, affirmant qu'il fallait désormais « le courage de prendre une décision ». Cette attaque fait suite à une fin de match sous haute tension contre le Japon, au cours de laquelle Carlo Ancelotti et l'attaquant Raphinha avaient été expulsés pour avoir protesté contre une faute présumée au départ de la troisième réalisation adverse.

Lucide quant au niveau affiché par ses joueurs sur le terrain, Carlo Ancelotti n'a éludé aucune question sur les difficultés actuelles de la Seleção. Lors de son point presse, le coach italien a dressé une autocritique sans concession sur le rendement de son groupe. « Je dois faire plus et je vais le faire. J'aime être ici, j'aime être dans la sélection nationale et je dois m'améliorer. Je dois faire plus pour que la sélection redevienne compétitive. Il y a longtemps que nous ne sommes plus compétitifs », a déclaré le technicien italien.

Toutefois, le sélectionneur brésilien a insisté sur la nature amicale de cette rencontre et la nécessité de renouveler son effectif en vue des futures échéances. « C'est évident que c'est le moment des essais. Nous essayons de nouveaux joueurs, en commençant par Gabriel Bontempo, André, Jonathan Jesus... Ce sont des évaluations très positives, sans mentionner de noms. Nous espérons toujours bien jouer, mais il est incompatible d'essayer, de renouveler et d'avoir l'équipe prête. Nous continuons avec une grande confiance dans cette voie et nous nous testerons contre Singapour », a détaillé le sélectionneur brésilien.

Après ce premier revers en Asie, le Brésil doit désormais se remobiliser pour son second match amical de la trêve internationale, prévu le mardi 17 novembre 2026 au Stade national de Singapour face à Singapour. Une rencontre que Carlo Ancelotti devra observer loin de la pelouse : le technicien italien est suspendu de banc de touche suite à son expulsion contre le Japon et ne pourra pas diriger directement ses hommes au bord du terrain. L'équipe devra également composer sans son attaquant Raphinha, lui aussi sous le coup d'une suspension. Pour animer son secteur offensif face aux Singapouriens, Carlo Ancelotti a d'ores et déjà annoncé la titularisation du jeune avant-centre Endrick pour le match du mardi 17 novembre 2026.

  • L'attaquant de 33 ans a surpris l'ensemble des observateurs au lendemain de la victoire de la Belgique face à l'Italie (4-1) en Ligue des nations, qui a validé la qualification des Diables Rouges pour les quarts de finale du tournoi.
  • It has been revealed that en quittant la sélection, Romelu Lukaku laisse un héritage statistique considérable.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

C'est une annonce majeure pour le football belge en ce lundi 16 novembre 2026. Sur son compte Instagram, Romelu Lukaku a officialisé son départ définitif de la sélection des Diables Rouges après seize années passées au plus haut niveau international.

L'attaquant de 33 ans a surpris l'ensemble des observateurs au lendemain de la victoire de la Belgique face à l'Italie (4-1) en Ligue des nations, qui a validé la qualification des Diables Rouges pour les quarts de finale du tournoi. Dimanche 15 novembre 2026, Romelu Lukaku est resté sur le banc des remplaçants sans entrer en jeu, après avoir manqué le match précédent face à la Turquie en raison d'une légère blessure à la hanche. Pour accompagner son message d'adieu sur le réseau social, le joueur a publié une galerie photo retraçant son parcours international depuis ses débuts en mars 2010 à l'âge de 16 ans. Plusieurs coéquipiers emblématiques de la génération dorée, dont Axel Witsel et Thibaut Courtois, ont d'ailleurs salué publiquement sa carrière sous sa publication. Une page se tourne pour les Diables Rouges.

It has been revealed that en quittant la sélection, Romelu Lukaku laisse un héritage statistique considérable. L'avant-centre se retire en effet en tant que meilleur buteur absolu de l'histoire de la sélection belge avec 94 buts inscrits en 135 sélections. Au niveau des apparitions, le joueur n'est devancé que par Jan Vertonghen (157 sélections) et Axel Witsel (140 sélections). Pilier de la sélection durant plus d'une décennie, il a disputé quatre phases finales de Coupe du monde (2014, 2018 avec une 3e place, 2022 et 2026) ainsi que trois Championnats d'Europe (2016, 2020 et 2024). Son dernier match officiel sous le maillot des Diables Rouges remonte ainsi au 5 octobre 2026 contre l'équipe de France en Ligue des nations, lors d'une défaite (1-4).

In a recent development, cette annonce constitue d'ailleurs un revirement par rapport aux intends initialement affichés par l'intéressé. En effet, l'attaquant avait affirmé en janvier 2026 que la Coupe du monde 2026 ne marquerait pas sa dernière compétition majeure avec la Belgique. La sélection des Diables Rouges a elle aussi tenu à rendre hommage à son avant-centre sur son compte officiel X, saluant un joueur qui a écrit un incroyable chapitre de l'histoire de l'équipe nationale.

It has been revealed that la situation sportive de l'attaquant s'était toutefois compliquée lors des dernières semaines avec les Diables Rouges. Depuis la prise de fonction de Mark van Bommel comme sélectionneur en août 2026 en remplacement de Rudi Garcia, Romelu Lukaku a vu son temps de jeu diminuer au profit de Charles De Ketelaere. Resté sur le banc lors du récent succès face à l'Italie, le joueur a finalement choisi de renoncer aux prochaines échéances internationales de son pays. En effet, la Belgique disputera les quarts de finale de la Ligue des nations du 25 au 30 mars 2027, dont le tirage au sort est fixé au vendredi 20 novembre 2026 à Nyon.

Sources indicate that toutefois, cette retraite internationale ne met absolument pas un terme à sa carrière en club. Romelu Lukaku évolue sous les couleurs de Fenerbahçe depuis le mois d'août 2026 et reste concentré sur ses objectifs en Turquie. L'attaquant disputera ainsi son prochain match officiel le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 17h00 face à Kocaelispor en Süper Lig.

In a recent development, présent en conférence de presse ce lundi 16 novembre 2026 à Singapour, Vinicius Jr a livré une mise au point sans détour sur ses récentes difficultés avec le Real Madrid. L'attaquant brésilien a admis avoir diminué son volume d'entraînement estival, profondément affecté par l'élimination précoce de sa sélection lors de la dernière Coupe du monde.

In a recent development, ce début d'exercice s'avère particulièrement difficile pour le joueur de 26 ans sous les couleurs du club espagnol. Avec un bilan de seulement un but et trois passes décisives en 12 rencontres toutes compétitions confondues avec le Real Madrid, Vinicius Jr traverse une période délicate. Un rendement bien loin de ses standards. La cause de ce passage à vide trouve son origine dans les suites de la Coupe du monde, où le Brésil a quitté la compétition dès les huitièmes de finale après une défaite face à la Norvège (2-1). Très affecté par ce revers, l'attaquant a ainsi privilégié le repos et la déconnexion en famille durant ses vacances, au détriment de sa préparation physique.

Devant les médias à Singapour, l'ailier madrilène a d'ailleurs détaillé avec franchise les raisons de ce déficit athlétique :.

According to recent reports, au-delà de cette déception internationale, le contexte extra-sportif n'a pas aidé le joueur du Real Madrid à aborder cette saison l'esprit totalement libéré. En effet, le dossier de sa prolongation contractuelle et les sollicitations extérieures, notamment l'intérêt de clubs comme Arsenal, ont perturbé sa concentration estivale. L'attaquant a ainsi reconnu que ces remous avaient directement influé sur son niveau de jeu depuis la reprise.

Toutefois, l'ailier madrilène a tenu à rappeler la difficulté de se maintenir au sommet dans la durée. Pour appuyer son constat, il a souligné que seuls Cristiano Ronaldo et Lionel Messi ont su afficher de telles statistiques pendant de longues années. Le numéro 7 brésilien a également rappelé son devoir d'exemplarité, affirmant être conscient que s'il court davantage, tous les jeunes joueurs courront aussi plus.

Vinicius Jr a tempéré les inquiétudes en comparant sa trajectoire à celle de la saison passée, où il ne comptait que 5 buts en décembre avant de dépasser la barre des 20 réalisations au printemps. L'attaquant reste ainsi convaincu que sa montée en puissance physique portera ses fruits au moment opportun.

Sur le plan sportif en sélection, Vinicius Jr s'est d'ailleurs redonné de la confiance en signant un doublé samedi 14 novembre 2026 lors de la défaite du Brésil contre le Japon (2-3) au Stade national de Singapour. Le Brésil dispute désormais son prochain match amical face à Singapour le mardi 17 novembre 2026 à 11h00 (heure française) au Stade national de Singapour. Le prochain rendez-vous de Vinicius Jr avec le Real Madrid est ensuite programmé le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 21h00 face au Celta Vigo au stade Santiago-Bernabéu pour la 13e journée de Liga.

By HARRY BAMFORTH, LIVE SPORTS COVERAGE REPORTER.

Erling Haaland saw a first half equaliser controversially disallowed against Fulham, as Enzo Maresca's side only managed to fight back to earn a disappointing draw.

Haaland latched onto a beautifully bent cross from Iliman Ndiaye to bundle home from less than eight minutes after Rodrigo Muniz had given the visitors a shock lead at the Etihad.

But despite Bernd Leno appearing to fumble the ball over the line and the referee's watch flashing to signify a goal, the man in the middle ruled the equaliser out for a foul on the Cottagers goalkeeper.

The decision has left both fans and pundits torn over whether the decision was harsh or whether it was the right call.

Former Arsenal and Chelsea midfielder Karen Carney stated her mind changed after having watched a replay of the incident.

Speaking on TNT Sports from the Etihad, she stated: 'My initial reaction was I thought the goalkeeper didn’t have control of it, and it should've been a goal, but then when you slow it down, (you can see it).

Erling Haaland has a first half equaliser for Man City chalked off against Fulham.

'People are going to shout at me through the TV. But I think the referee made the right decision.'.

Tottenham legend Glenn Hoddle, also on punditry duty in Manchester, felt the same.

In a recent development, he said: 'I don’t know whether he had control of it, but I don’t think that comes into it. I think that’s the right decision, but it’s a very tough call. It could have gone either way.'.

The Premier League Match Centre clarified why the decision was made by Tom Bramall and the VAR team in Stockley Park.

A statement on social media read: 'The referee’s call of free-kick to Fulham and no goal to Manchester City was checked and confirmed by VAR – with the goalkeeper deemed to be in control of the ball.'.

They added that the VAR said: 'The ball is in control between both hands and then is played out of that possession by the attacker, and then into the back of the net.'.

The laws of the game state that a goalkeeper is believed to be in control of the ball when the ball is 'between their hands/arms or between their hand(s)/arm(s) and any surface'.

In a recent development, not all fans, of a Manchester City persuasion or not, felt that the right decision was made. Some believed that both Haaland and City should feel hard done by.

Haaland was left in disbelief by the referee's decision with many fans feeling the same.

Sources indicate that an Arsenal fan made their stance clear: 'Even as a rival, I honestly think this Haaland goal should’ve stood for Manchester City. Would’ve been p***** off if a Gyokeres goal like this for Arsenal was cancelled.'.

A different fan added: 'Manchester City has been robbed. Haaland scored a clean goal here. The ball went in even before Haaland had contact with the keeper.

Not everyone agreed, though, with many X people taking the opposite stance.

Industry observers note that one mentioned: 'It’s explicitly a foul under the Laws. Don’t blame the ref if you don’t like the laws.'.

Another user wrote: 'I am also an Arsenal fan but the ball is still in two-palm contact. If you allow it, you will encourage outfield player challenging the save attempt And a foot to hand challenge will much more often lead to a broken wrist or thumb. That is an unfair advantage to outfield players.'.

City did go on to equalise in the second half, with Elliot Anderson bagging his first Premier League goal for the club by smashing home a sublime volley in the 57th minute.

Tottenham Hotspur have never before in the club’s history begun a league season without scoring a single goal in the first four games, although having done so after spending £329m on newly introduced players really does take some doing.

In a recent development, “Please score a goal!” was the homemade sign from two Spurs fans upon which the television cameras lingered at the end of the game, although the jaunty felt-tip design and glued-on team crest were rather upbeat compared to the gloom of the stadium. Spurs have tried to outrun their past but it just keeps catching up with them.

A team reimagined, a manager freshly launched and yet they are back in the same grip of anxiety that accompanied them on two consecutive 17th-place finishes in the last two seasons. By the end of this they might have been glad to escape with a single point against Everton, the one team in the Premier League who closed the window with a net transfer profit.

According to recent reports, for Roberto De Zerbi, there was another passionate defence of his team afterwards. “The people, the fans already understand if I make excuses or not,” he said. “I came last season when the s--- was like this”, he gestured to a level somewhere around the midpoint of his forehead. “I have always been… not positive but realistic. I am sorry for the result that it’s not immediately the improvement. We played as a team. We didn’t score. We didn’t win [but] we played as a team.”.

Indeed he co-opted the Italian term “sbloccare” to describe his team’s problem. They simply need to unlock – or unblock – the team and the goals would flow. He joked that in Italy he would be lauded for two consecutive clean sheets in this game and the previous one against Nottingham Forest. “What did you write?” he demanded of one of the Italian newspaper correspondents. “You have the passport.”.

According to recent reports, spurs have one last game at home this month, on Saturday against Aston Villa, to end the streak in September. They were into the second half before the first attempt on target that obliged Jordan Pickford to make a save – Mateus Fernandes’s shot slapping limply against the Everton goalkeeper’s gloves to ironic cheers from the home fans.

According to recent reports, at the end De Zerbi could not contain his frustration, unable to wait until he reached the privacy of the dressing room to tell Mathys Tel where he had gone wrong. He did so with the Spurs substitute still wiping the sweat from his brow on the pitch. The player did not look at all impressed. De Zerbi stated later that he was simply reminding his player of what it took to play as a central striker.

“There is a term in Italian, ‘sbloccare’ that literally translates as ‘unblock’… I know we can score goals and win games. We have to respect the history of the players – if you forget [Dominic] Solanke and [Omar] Marmoush the others haven’t scored many in their careers. I think we can find the goals with the quality of the players.”.

Spurs play Liverpool at Anfield in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday before Villa a week today. The Spurs record at home is dismal. In the last 35 games they have won just five, drawn 10 and lost a remarkable 20. This new stadium has become a problem for the team in it – or maybe it is the other way around.

In a recent development, A good result for Everton, who were under pressure for most of the first half but had much the better of it after the break. David Moyes’s team finished the game with more shots on target than the home team. Moyes managed the game well and trusted his team to withstand the Spurs possession in the first half until they reached a point where Everton could start to push back.

Hard to pick out any major chances – it was that kind of game – but Brennan Johnson should have won it for the away team in the second half. The ball was cut back to him by Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall and the former Spurs man skied his shot.

Recent findings suggest that some surprised faces then when Moyes said later that he had expected a lot more from his team. He acknowledged the resilience in defence and the importance of the clean sheet. “We played well enough,” he said, “but when we had the ball we turned it over more often than we should have done.”.

The game had started with Vitaliy Mykolenko being tortured by the pace of Sávio and ended with the Ukrainian left-back being given the man of the match award. Like many of his team-mates, he had hung in there. There was another fine performance from Jarrad Branthwaite at centre-half and Moyes remarked that he hoped it might earn him a place in the England squad. “He is still finding his way back from injury,” Moyes said, “it would be great if he could get a call-up.”.

According to recent reports, in the directors’ box were the usual pained expressions of Vinai Venkatesham, the Spurs chief executive, and chairman Peter Charrington. They sat alongside Vivienne Lewis, daughter of the patriarch Joe. There is a certain fatigue about the home crowd when faced with afternoons like this which suggests they have seen so much that the bar is quite high – or low – to provoke a really splenetic response. Perhaps it is just too early in the season although the final whistle was met with boos.

The first shot on target of the entire game for either side was a free-kick struck by James Garner in added time at the end of the first half. Spurs had started at a ferocious pace although they could not sustain it.

De Zerbi complained about the pre-season injuries on tour in Australia and also the lack of time he had to integrate Sávio and Marmoush. He mentioned that his team were not in the right “physical condition”.

It has been revealed that “We played very well in the first 30 minutes and maybe the energy and the fact we didn’t score – we lost confidence.” By the end, he had sent on James Maddison, Tel, Lucas Bergvall and Mohammed Kudus to little avail. Everton looked more likely to win it.

In a recent development, speaking to Sky Sports, the Everton defender remarked: “You look at the game from the start, they put us under pressure and we had to dig deep to stay in the game. Then we grew into the game towards the end of the first half and showed that mentality again in the second half.

Recent findings suggest that “We had chances to win the game as well. The backs to the wall mentality will help us go a long way. If we can keep clean sheets, you can go a long way in the league. But it’s not just us the defenders. It’s the whole team working hard. It’s a team effort.”.

Industry observers note that tottenham failed to take the attacking initiative or create any notable chances. De Zerbi used multiple forward players in a host of attacking positions, but no one could find the breakthrough.

In a recent development, boos ring around the ground as Spurs and Everton both have to settle for a point. Tottenham’s winless start to the season continues, while Everton’s unbeaten run remains intact. Spurs haven’t managed a goal in six hours of Premier League football across the 2026-27 campaign. Tottenham sit 17th with two points. Everton are up to seventh and will certainly take the draw.

Industry observers note that de Zerbi makes another change as Maddison enters the action with applause from the Spurs faithful. He replaces Marmoush. It looks like Tel is now operating as a false nine.

That opportunity is Johnson’s last action of the match as he comes off for Hackney. O’Brien is also introduced, replacing Maitland-Niles.

That was the chance. Dewsbury-Hall rolls it into the path of Spurs’ Europa League final winner Brennan Johnson and he skied it. He hasn’t scored since he left Spurs in January for Palace.

Everton look like the far likelier side to break the deadlock. De Zerbi’s changes have done little to affect the game. Marmoush is cutting a very frustrated figure up top for Spurs.

Dewsbury-Hall picks up the game’s first yellow card after catching Tonali with a late sliding challenge.

The Tottenham man redeems himself with a crucial save to keep the scoreline goalless. The hosts are living so dangerously. Kinsky needs to wake up.

Moyes responds with a straight swap on the wing as Grealish comes on for George.

Sources indicate that enter: Grealish. He is on for Tyrique George. Surprised that Brennan Johnson survived that change. He has struggled to make an impression.

Following Spurs’ reshuffle, it looks like Savio will stay out wide on the right, with Tel on the left. Kudus will sit as the central playmaker behind Marmoush, who is now the lone frontman.

De Zerbi orders a much-needed triple change as Kudus, Tel and Bergvall replace Solanke, Fernandes and Bentancur.

Sources indicate that A couple of chances for Everton. Spurs have survived but they look so vulnerable when Everton turn over possession. Crowd could turn soon. Almost reached the hour-mark on matchday 4 and still no Spurs’ Premier League goal.

In a recent development, the start of Spurs’ second-half performance is alarmingly similar to their display against Newcastle two weeks ago. That day, Tottenham allowed Newcastle to seize the initiative and they netted two second-half goals without reply. Everton are gaining confidence as Spurs continue to lack courage or threat. The crowd is getting more and more restless.

Industry observers note that tottenham fail to clear a corner and the ball lands at George’s feet. The Everton winger shoots but his fierce drive is blocked by Bentancur. The whole of Spurs’ bench is warming up. The visitors at the moment have the momentum and the hosts look nervous.

Spurs’ first shot has arrived! Unfortunately, Fernandes’ tame long-range effort is easily gathered by Pickford. There were some sarcastic cheers from the Tottenham fans as Fernandes took aim. They clearly want more attacking inspiration from their players.

Ironic cheers as Spurs have their first shot on target. It has taken them until the start of the second half and it would be hard to say Fernandes stung the palms of Pickford.

We are back under way for the second half. Everton and Spurs are both unchanged at the break. With the anxiety building in the stadium as the game remains goalless, how long will De Zerbi wait before making a change?

James Garner free-kick pushed away by Kinsky is the game’s first attempt on target.

That is so poor from Fernandes. The summer signing’s overhit corner drifts out for a goal kick. Suddenly, Spurs’ attacking play has fallen quite flat.

Pickford does well to intercept Robertson’s inviting low cross. The left back needed Solanke or Marmoush to make a darting near-post run there to give him more options.

Spurs are bossing this game but on the rare occasions Everton escape you do wonder if they might score.

Spurs are really flowing here. Finding the balls through the lines and real speed when they attack Everton. Big question is whether they can convert that into goals. Van Hecke and Fernandes both had chances.

Brennan Johnson spent two years at Tottenham and scored the winning goal in the 1-0 Europa League final victory over Manchester United in May 2025, ending the club’s 17-year trophy drought.

After a short, disappointing spell at Crystal Palace, Johnson joined Everton last month, with Dwight McNeil moving in the opposite direction.

The Welsh winger starts for Everton today. Could he hurt his previous employers on a day where they desperately need a win?

Brennan in the building. 💙 pic.twitter.com/94GgAY8c56.

Midfielder took exception to negativity surrounding club after moves for players on deadline day failed to materialise.

“We signed Jack [Grealish], which was nice, and I’d been speaking to him,” says Dewsbury-Hall, sitting in a café at the club’s Finch Farm training base. “But I had seen all the stuff [online], all the meltdowns about this and that and, in all honestly, it annoyed me a bit.

“I get where people are coming from. Everyone wants to sign everyone and have the perfect squad, but there are still 19 lads in this building who are going to hopefully take this club to good things this year. That was getting disregarded. I was seeing people saying: ‘We’ll be lucky to stay up this year.’.

According to recent reports, “What message is that sending to the lads who are already here? I’m not blaming anyone. We get it. It didn’t work. But let’s all be positive – right, it’s done, bang, let’s go. That’s what we’ve been trying to say in the dressing room.”.

Earlier this week, Mykhailo Mudryk picked up an ankle injury in training which has ruled the Chelsea loanee out of action for as long as two months.

The winger only made his debut for Tottenham as a late substitute against Nottingham Forest last week, but his attempt to rebuild his career following his anti-doping ban has been dealt a major blow.

Folarin Balogun’s proposed £39m move from Monaco collapsed on transfer deadline day, Richarlison’s return to the club didn’t materialise and Beto was sold to Fiorentina, leaving Thierno Barry as Everton’s only recognised striker.

Nottingham Forest’s pursuit of academy product Harrison Armstrong ruffled the fans’ feathers, while Iliman Ndiaye was sold to Manchester City for £60m.

Dwight McNeil, Tim Iroegbunam, Nathan Patterson, Adam Aznou and Idrissa Gueye were also allowed to leave.

Merlin Rohl and Tyrique George made their loans permanent, while Brennan Johnson, Hayden Hackney and Christian Norgaard were also added to the squad.

Summer signing Ainsley Maitland-Niles and Vitaliy Mykolenko are David Moyes’ only options at full-back.

Overall, there were a number of solid additions, just not enough of them to cover all the departures.

Tottenham: Kinsky; Gray, Van de Ven, Van Hecke, Robertson; Tonali, Bentancur, Fernandes; Savio, Solankem, Marmoush.

Subs: Dubravka, Tosin, Senesi, Gallagher, Maddison, Tel, Bergvall, Kudus, Davies.

Everton: Pickford; Maitland-Niles, Tarkowski, Brathwaite, Mykolenko; Armstrong, Garner; Johnson, Dewsbury-Hall, George; Barry.

Subs: Travers, O’Brien, Keane, King, Alcaraz, Graham, Hackney, Dibling, Grealish.

After scoring that last-minute leveller against Manchester United last time out, Ainsley Maitland-Niles is promoted to the starting 11 and replaces Merlin Rohl. Brennan Johnson returns to his former club and starts, while Jack Grealish is on the bench.

Roberto De Zerbi has made four alterations from last weekend’s stalemate with Nottingham Forest. Dominic Solanke, Mateus Fernandes, Archie Gray and Andy Robertson all come into the line-up. Pedro Porro and Destiny Udogie are out injured, while Conor Gallagher and Mathys Tel are relegated to the bench. Tosin Adarabioyo and James Maddison are also among the substitutes.

Our Spurs side to take on Everton 👊🔢 @krakenfx pic.twitter.com/n637s7swiD.

Hello and welcome to our live coverage of this Premier League meeting between Tottenham and Everton in the capital.

Are Tottenham in must-win territory already? It may seem reactionary and premature, but after spending £380m in the summer to revamp an underperforming squad, Tottenham sit inside the relegation zone, with just one point and zero goals scored in three games.

Roberto De Zerbi’s men opened the 2026-27 top-flight season with worrying back-to-back defeats to Brentford and Newcastle United, before ending their losing streak last weekend thanks to a goalless draw against Nottingham Forest.

According to recent reports, this game gives Tottenham another opportunity to reverse their dreadful home form. Last season, Spurs managed just three league wins at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and lost 10. The recent 2-0 loss against Newcastle was a painful reminder of Spurs’ shortcomings at home, but they’ll be expected to be authoritative and seize the initiative here today. A much-needed three points would be the perfect remedy to ease the pressure and unwanted attention on De Zerbi and his squad.

In a recent development, meanwhile, Everton have made an unbeaten start to the season, accumulating five points from their first three league matches. David Moyes’ side looked set for defeat last time out, when they were trailing Manchester United 2-1 at the Hill Dickinson Stadium heading into stoppage time, until Ainsley Maitland-Niles’ stunning 96th-minute equaliser salvaged a draw.

Industry observers note that alongside drama on the pitch, there has also been noise off it. A bizarre transfer window has left Everton with a serious lack of depth up top and in both full-back positions. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall responded to the fans’ negativity over this situation, saying their meltdowns “annoyed” him.

Nevertheless, they arrive in North London with all eyes on Tottenham and if the hosts can find a first league victory this season.

Kick-off is at 17:30, with team news coming shortly.

Mauricio Pochettino has issued a rallying cry to Manchester United supporters, promising that this is going to be a 'special season' despite their dismal start which sees them 18th in the Premier League with just one win from their opening 10 games.

The newly introduced Red Devils head coach landed in Manchester on Wednesday morning, hopping straight off a private jet to meet his new players, hours after leading the USA in his final game as their boss.

And during a busy first day among his new surroundings, the Argentine sent a direct message to the club's fanbase as he preached for unity.

'Hi Reds, here's it's Mauricio Pochettino,' he said via a video posted on United's X account at 7.15pm on Wednesday evening.

It has been revealed that 'I am looking forward to meeting you guys. I hear so many good things about you.

'I hope we bring all the happiness working together and connecting together.

A message from Mauricio 💬❤️🤳 #ShotOnSnapdragon pic.twitter.com/2lBLkMaGY6.

Mauricio Pochettino addressed Manchester United fans directly on Wednesday evening after starting work officially as their new head coach.

The upcoming Red Devils head coach has promised a 'special season' in a direct message to fans.

Pochettino poses at his unveiling with United director of football Jason Wilcox on Wednesday.

'This is going to be a special season to support and to make our players to fight on the field and to get the results that we deserve.'.

It has been revealed that in a second message in his native Spanish, Pochettino expanded further: 'This message is about being united, like the name Manchester United. We all need to work together.

'I hope to bring the happy moments that this club deserves and create the unity that every team needs so that the players can be at their best on the pitch.'.

According to recent reports, those messages came less than eight hours after arriving in England. He landed in Manchester at 11.32am on Wednesday and immediately headed to their Carrington training base where he took a tour and met players and staff.

It has been revealed that speaking to the club's media channels earlier on Wednesday, Pochettino said: 'Thank you so much, I'm very excited to be here. It's an honour, it's a privilege to be in this amazing club. I'm looking forward to starting work.'.

The club then officially welcomed the fresh manager on their website, writing: 'Mauricio Pochettino has officially started work as Manchester United head coach, marking the start of a dream role for the Argentinian.

It has been revealed that 'Pochettino is joined at United by a team of loyal staff he has worked with at Espanyol, Southampton, Tottenham Hotspur, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea and USA. Join us in welcoming Jesus Perez, Miguel D’Agostino, Toni Jimenez, Alec Scott and Sebastiano Pochettino.'.

Pochettino had made a promise to end Man City's dominance as United manager in his last interview as United States national team coach on Tuesday evening.

He took off from northern Kentucky in a private jet chartered by the club after his final match on American soil, which saw the US beat Haiti 2-0 in Cincinnati.

But before becoming airborne, Pochettino had time for a final statement Stateside, after being taunted that 'Manchester is blue, and will always be blue' by one of his interviewers.

Earlier on Wednesday, Pochettino made his way to Carrington straight after landing in Manchester, meeting players and staff and taking a tour.

The Argentine took off from northern Kentucky in a private jet last night and landed at 11.32am.

The manager shared a picture from his journey as he prepared to touch down at the airport (Source: Instagram/Mauricio Pochettino).

Sources indicate that 'No way,' he shook his head. 'You will see.'.

According to recent reports, 'Give me time. Give me time and then that - that's going to change.'.

Pochettino also shared a poignant farewell message to his US set-up, days after breaking down in tears in a press conference ahead of his penultimate time in charge.

Man United fans may also have been pleased to read of Pochettino's new-found love of John Denver's song Country Roads in his goodbye message, a song which is played before kick-off at Old Trafford.

'It is never easy to say goodbye, especially after everything we experienced together.' Pochettino captioned a carousel of photos of his time in the role. 'I always wanted the opportunity to coach in the USA, and I was very happy to have this chance with the national team. Two incredible years, with so many great moments and experiences that will stay with me always.

'From the challenges we faced at the Gold Cup to the excitement of the USA hosting the World Cup, and now finishing our time by reaching the semi-finals of the Nations League, I am proud of what we achieved.

'When we arrived, I wanted us to believe that we could compete with anyone. I hope today that belief is stronger, not only with the players but with everyone who supports this team. Not everything in football can be measured by results, and I believe we have helped build something important for the future of soccer in this country.

The plane believed to be carrying Pochettino and his staff was hired by Manchester United.

'This experience has re-energised me and given me so much, both in football and personally. I have discovered a wonderful country, made latest friends and enjoyed so many of the traditions. Every time I hear Country Roads, I will forever think of all of you with a smile.

According to recent reports, 'Thank you to the players, staff, everyone at (the US national team) and all the supporters. Especially to those who believed in us and gave us this opportunity.

Sources indicate that 'Leaving is tough at this moment, but sometimes in football an opportunity comes that is impossible to say no to. I have always believed in following my heart, even when it means leaving a place where I have been very happy.

It has been revealed that 'I hope this team continues to grow and achieves all the success it deserves. Thank you USA.'.

Pochettino had previously explained his emotions as stemming from how difficult the decision had been to leave the national team and re-start at Old Trafford.

‘I haven't prepared a speech, I'm talking with my heart,’ he said on Friday. ‘It's difficult for me to talk now because I am a very emotional guy.

It has been revealed that ‘When these moments arrive, it is always tough. Normally it is the opposite – you have been sacked! You cry because you want to stay.

‘I think it was one of the most difficult decisions of our career, but you have to move forward.

According to recent reports, ‘Not too many opportunities can happen in your career with a side like Manchester United. That is difficult to turn down when it arrives.

According to recent reports, ‘In some part it’s a very sad decision, in another part we are professional and we are trying to make our dreams come true. We are excited for that step forward.'.

Man United first made contact with Pochettino following their breathless 4-4 draw against Aston Villa in their last match before the international break.

The Man United hierarchy had previously given former head coach Michael Carrick a stay of execution amid a worrying start to the season, but as they prepared to head into the two-week pause in the relegation zone, the board became keen to make a change.

An agonising wait for Carrick followed, with the club legend taking training for multiple sessions at the start of the week as his future was openly mulled by executives including CEO Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox.

After the duo returned from Monaco, where they had flown to speak to co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe about Carrick's future, the 45-year-old was finally dispatched last Thursday morning.

In their statement regarding Pochettino's arrival on Wednesday, United also confirmed the exits of Carrick and Co, writing: 'The club can confirm the departures of Travis Binnion, Jonny Evans, Steve Holland, Craig Mawson and Jonathan Woodgate alongside Michael Carrick.

'We would like to thank the group for their total commitment, dedication and professionalism, and we wish them all good luck for the future.'.

Pochettino's United States farewell match went off in pitch-perfect style, which allowed thoughts to swiftly move to the next task at hand after the final whistle.

Christian Pulisic helped make sure that Pochettino's reign in charge ended on a high note.

The manager will now focus his attentions on getting Man United out of the relegation zone.

'When you finish the game, you start in your mind to think about different things,' Pochettino noted after the win. 'Of course, it's tough because it's emotional. Because I really love these guys, and I love the players. I love the staff. I love the fans and everything.'.

Travelling with Pochettino were outgoing USMNT first-team coach Miguel D'Agostino, strength and conditioning coach Silvia Tuya and analyst Alec Scott, while his assistant Jesus Perez, goalkeeper coach Toni Jimenez as well as Pochettino's son and fitness coach Sebastiano have already begun preparing for Sunday's matchup with Liverpool at Anfield.

Man United paid a staggering £10million to cleave Pochettino and his staff away from the United States, after the head coach signed a newly introduced contract with the national team in the wake of this summer's World Cup.

It has been revealed that the quick turnaround means Pochettino will be able to work with the players as they begin reporting back from international duty. Furthermore, he is expected to speak to club media before conducting his pre-match press conference around lunchtime on Friday.

Before boarding his flight, Pochettino not only waved to his adoring fans, but took a photo with staff and players on the pitch in Cincinnati.

'It's impossible not to cry, but that is because we care about the people and the people care about us,' he told reporters. 'When that happens, it's normal to show your emotions, no? Because we are human. We are no robots.'.
